purpose: Add a substantive terrain evidence branch, not replace unavailable registered inference with selected-subset significance claims.
question: What do the already fitted terrain configurations predict, and how do the existing scores depend on configuration and horizon?

tree.Background: Separate history-plus-terrain branch, all ten fitted configurations; ordinary HSM-SDE/CV comparison is different.
tree.Evidence population: Original46 blocks,2300 slots,2297 success,3 failures; common43 blocks selected only by success of all50 forecasts per block; no imputation.
Results: T2: factor configuration and horizon trade-offs
tree.Qualification: Post-hoc selected-subset description, larger paired-subset sensitivity, refitting/interactions/regularisation confounds and unchanged original family rule.
tree.Interpretation and conclusion: No uniform descriptive gain from adding all terrain groups; targeted representation/fitting and horizon-specific assessment are motivated, not isolated causal factor verdicts.

claims.claim: On common43 blocks all-terrain changes ES by+26.98m and FDE by+39.00m against base; 30-minute ES+69.11m, but22/43 blocks have lower average ES.
claims.qualification: Heterogeneous selected-subset result, no significant harm or inherent terrain-uselessness claim.

claims.claim: Road-only ES+42.96m; removing road from all-terrain ES-19.87m. River-only improves15-minute ES but worsens30-minute ES. Land-cover-only has a small favourable mean, and surface-only trades score against mean location.
claims.qualification: Full fitted configurations, not independent causal factor effects; river near-zero average changes sign on larger paired subsets.

claims.claim: All ten30-minute nominal90% coverage means lie40.47–52.09%; all-terrain has lower coverage despite slightly larger area than base.
claims.qualification: Same43-block subset, five simulation circles per target; not independent participants or calibrated long-horizon regions.

relations.note: Training is performed; equations are not empirical benefit evidence.
Two presentations of the same saved data, not independent replications.
Checks direction sensitivity to selected blocks, not a new inferential test.
Conclusions remain descriptive; this does not erase actual observed results.
Uniform-gain hypothesis not supported descriptively on this subset; no causal chain or full-cohort verdict.
